Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference Yellow_Leaf image shows more advanced/severe symptoms (widespread drying). The test image shows an earlier stage: a green leaf with a single yellow stripe along the midrib — exactly matching the Yellow_Leaf description of "yellowing specifically of the midribs."

Key evidence:
- Single yellow stripe along the central midrib, not multiple scattered streaks (rules out Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv)
- No mosaic/mottled green-yellow patchwork pattern (rules out Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus)
- No white pencil line or scalded edges (rules out Leaf_Scald)
- Matches Yellow_Leaf early-stage presentation: midrib yellowing on an otherwise green leaf
